GITHUB_API_ORIGIN is the literal https://api.github.com. Owner must match /^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,39}$/ and kind is the local orgs/users enumeration. redirect:error rejects relocation, and response URL must exactly equal the requested owner-bound URL.
rows.review_method: Manual inspection of the complete URL construction and redirect handling in the exact source file bound by source_sha256.

rows.reason: All requests concatenate the literal https://api.github.com origin with a locally checked slash-rooted path. Fetch uses redirect:manual. Every redirect is checked for the same exact origin and absence of URL credentials before the next fetch; hop count is bounded to three and unsafe mutation redirects are rejected.
